2026-09-29 08:10:58.321503 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-29 08:10:58.321506 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-09-29 08:10:58.321510 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-09-29 08:10:58.321513 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
